title: Servex crashed again at 00:52 with no clue left; crash dumps still off

owner_note.text: Servex died at about 00:52 without writing a node report or a dump, the same kind of native crash as on 11-02, so its cause can't be found. Turning on crash dumps is one admin command, about 2 minutes, in the first step of the waiting crash-dump task; after that, the next crash leaves a file I can analyze.
